statement_map.email_excerpt: You called because your form was bringing in leads, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, then submitted a test form using your other email address and confirmed that the autoresponder email arrived.
Emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings. You mentioned that you planned to do this the morning after our call.
